name: Instant Side Cart for WooCommerce
author: Balachandar I

sections.description:
🚀 Instant Side Cart for WooCommerce: Boost Sales with AJAX
The Instant Side Cart for WooCommerce provides a blazing fast, responsive side cart drawer that loads instantly without refreshing the page. Stop losing customers to slow, cumbersome cart pages and provide a seamless, modern shopping experience that drives conversions.

✨ Key Features in the Free Version
The Instant Side Cart delivers crucial features right out of the box to boost your store’s user experience (UX) and average order value (AOV).

⚡ AJAX Functionality: Add products to the cart instantly from the Shop page, product pages, or anywhere else on your site without a page reload.

🎁 Free Shipping Progress Bar: Motivate customers to increase their order value! A highly visible progress bar shows the exact amount remaining to unlock free shipping, turning a missed sale into a bigger order.

🛒 Seamless Cart Management: Allow users to update product quantities (+/- buttons) and remove items directly within the side cart, all via fast AJAX.

📱 Fully Responsive Design: The side cart drawer and floating trigger button are optimized for all screen sizes, providing a smooth, touch-friendly experience on mobile devices.

👁️ Smart Trigger Button: A sticky, floating cart icon displays the current item count and automatically opens the cart drawer when a new product is successfully added.

⚙️ Basic Controls: Simple settings to enable/disable the cart and set your Free Shipping Threshold.

🌟 Go Pro for Advanced Customization & Performance
Ready to take your conversions to the next level? Upgrade to Instant Side Cart Pro to unlock powerful features necessary for full design control and marketing optimization.

12 Eye-Catching Animations: Choose from effects like Bounce, Pulse, Shake, and Tada for your floating icon to grab your customers’ attention.

Advanced Icon Styling: Access 6 pre-built icon presets, custom SVG upload options, and full color/size control for both desktop and mobile views.

Layout Control: Set custom width and height for the cart panel (e.g., full-width mobile cart).

Mobile-First Settings: Dedicated options to set separate icon positions, sizes, and cart widths specifically for mobile devices.
sections.faq:
Does it work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, it is designed to work with any standard WooCommerce setup.

Is the Pro version a separate plugin?

Yes, the Pro version is an add-on plugin that requires the free version to be active.

Why do I need the Pro version?

The Pro version unlocks all the features necessary for design customization and marketing optimization that drive sales. This includes the 12 attention-grabbing animations, 6 icon presets, custom icon uploads, and dedicated mobile styling controls (size, color, position) not available in the free version.

How do I change the Free Shipping Threshold?

You can easily adjust the target amount by navigating to WooCommerce > Settings > Side Cart (or whatever menu item you created) and updating the “Free Shipping Threshold” field. This change immediately updates the progress bar on the front end.

My floating cart button isn’t visible on mobile. What should I do?

The cart trigger button should be fully visible by default. If it’s missing, ensure it’s not being hidden by custom CSS from your theme. The Pro version offers dedicated Mobile Settings to control the position, size, and color of the trigger specifically for smaller screens, making it much easier to ensure visibility.
